Section 1. Data Privacy and Protection Obligations
ABC Technologies, Inc. ('ABC') and XYZ Solutions Ltd. ('XYZ') agree to comply with all applicable data privacy laws and regulations pertaining to the processing of personal data under this Agreement, effective November 1, 2023. ABC must implement and maintain appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data against unauthorized access or disclosure by December 31, 2023. XYZ must promptly notify ABC of any data breach involving personal data within 48 hours of discovering the breach. Both parties must ensure that any third-party processors engaged in the processing of personal data comply with equivalent data protection obligations.

Section 2. Confidentiality Obligations and Restrictions
Confidentiality: Both parties, Tech Innovations LLC ("Recipient") and Green Solutions Inc. ("Discloser"), agree that any and all information exchanged between them on or after November 1, 2023, that is marked as confidential shall be treated as confidential information. The Recipient must not disclose such information to any third party without prior written consent from the Discloser. Furthermore, the Recipient must ensure that any confidential information is used solely for the purpose of fulfilling obligations under this agreement and must employ reasonable security measures to protect the confidentiality of such information. These obligations shall remain in effect for a period of three (3) years from the date of termination of this agreement.

Section 3. Insurance Coverage and Proof
ABC Corporation (hereinafter referred to as 'ABC Corp') shall maintain comprehensive general liability insurance coverage with a minimum limit of $2,000,000 per occurrence throughout the duration of this Agreement, effective from January 1, 2024, to December 31, 2025. ABC Corp must provide XYZ Enterprises (hereinafter referred to as 'XYZ') with a certificate of insurance evidencing such coverage no later than January 10, 2024. In the event of any changes to the policy, including cancellation or modification, ABC Corp must notify XYZ in writing at least 30 days prior to the effective date of such changes.

Section 4. Non-Compete Obligation for John Doe
Effective as of January 1, 2024, and for a period of twelve (12) months thereafter, John Doe (the 'Employee') agrees that he shall not, within the geographical region of the United States, directly or indirectly engage in, own, manage, operate, control, be employed by, consult for, or participate in any manner with any business substantially similar to or in competition with the business of XYZ Corp. (the 'Company'). Further, the Employee must not solicit or attempt to solicit any business from any of the Company's customers with whom the Employee had material contact during his employment with the Company.

Section 5. Contract Auto-Renewal
This Agreement between Tech Solutions Inc. ("Provider") and Greenfield Enterprises ("Client") shall automatically renew for successive one-year terms commencing on January 1, 2024, unless either party provides written notice of intent not to renew at least 60 days prior to the expiration of the then-current term. The Client must ensure full payment of any outstanding fees at least 30 days prior to the renewal date. The Provider may, at its discretion, review and adjust the service fees for the forthcoming term, provided that the Client is notified of such changes at least 45 days before the renewal date.
